CSE-4066                                                                                                                   about:srcdoc  
  
  
  Exam Date & Time: 27-Nov-2024 (02:30 PM - 05:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  MIT BLR - BTech VII Semester - End Semester Examination - Nov / Dec -2024  
  Ethical Hacking and Cyber Security [CSE-4066]  
  Marks: 50                                                                                  Duration: 180 mins.  
  PART-A  
  Answer all the questions.  
  1)           Identify and explain different types of active attacks and passive attacks.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Consider you are working in a company named XYZ solutions as ethical hacker wherein  
  you need to perform some penetration testing. Demonstrate the tool which can used for (5)  
  this task along with the sample code.  
  
  2)           Consider you are being given the task of gathering information during the enumeration  
  process. Examine the different types of enumeration in detail.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Examine the Linux vulnerability with an example tool demonstration.                          (5)  
  3)           Illustrate how web applications interact with databases, including the use of SQL queries  
  and data retrieval. Explain how this interaction can be exploited if not secured properly.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Discuss the following:  
  i) ODBC                                                                                      (5)  
  ii) ActiveX Data Objects (ADO)  
  
  4)           Demonstrate how phishing attacks target specific individuals or organizations and  
  discuss the impact these attacks can have on personal data and organizational security.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Explain the concept of a Trojan horse in cybersecurity and discuss how attackers use  
  backdoors to gain unauthorized access to system.                                             (5)  
  
  5)           Examine the importance of two-factor authentication in reducing real time credit card  
  fraud in mobile transactions. What are some challenges in implementing this security  
  (5)  
  feature?  
  A)  
  B)      Examine with a real time example how cryptographic techniques, such as hashing and           (5)  
  encryption, help secure sensitive data in web applications.
